info.title: gcf - token-optimized wire format for LLM tool responses
info.description: Command-line interface for GCF (Graph Compact Format): encode, decode, and token-comparison stats. Installs the `gcf` command.

commands.name: decode
commands.description: Decode GCF graph text to JSON (stdin if no file)

commands.name: decode-generic
commands.description: Decode generic GCF to JSON (stdin if no file)

commands.name: encode
commands.description: Encode a JSON graph payload to GCF (stdin if no file)

commands.name: encode-generic
commands.description: Encode generic JSON to GCF (stdin if no file)

commands.name: stats
commands.description: Compare token counts: JSON vs GCF (stdin if no file)
